thread:
maria: Ran a regional + mixed-QPS sweep on 7B (short/med/long = 30/60/10) comparing A100 -> H100, quant = q8x4 and q4_0. Batch=4, prefix-heavy workload (KV cache hit ~15% on med/long). Summary: H100 wins tokens/sec and tail decode.
aj: Numbers? p95/delta and cost?
maria: Key numbers (US region): H100 tokens/sec ~610, A100 ~475. p95 decode improvement ~20ms on H100. Observed $/1M tokens (US): H100 ~$3.6, A100 ~$5.1. EU pricing increases both ~10-12% (EU H100 ~$4.0, EU A100 ~$5.7). Charts: http://internal/bench/3765432100/charts.png
cheng: Any kernel fallbacks or unexpected matmuls on A100 at long seq?
maria: Yes, on A100 at seq > 1024 we saw fast-attn not selected in a few slices. Logs show: ```kernel_select: fallback matmul_generic for seq=1536 q8x4``` Happened ~3% of runs in that tail slice. H100 used fast-attn consistently.
liz: That's the weird selector bug we saw previously. We should prefer fast-attn for seq<=2048 when supported. I'll open a runtime PR to bias selection.
perf-qa: Quality tradeoffs between q8x4 and q4_0? Need eval numbers for migration guidance.
maria: Quick eval on our conv-QA devset: q8x4 negligible delta vs fp16. q4_0 shows +1.8% perplexity and ~1.1% higher factual error on short factual prompts. Full matrix at: http://internal/bench/3765432100/eval.csv
aj: What about cold-start tails + microbursts? Batch=4 might hide some things.
maria: Agreed. Plan a night run with batch=8 and synthetic microbursts (saw microburst p99 spikes on A100). Also will run with KV cache warm vs cold to show effective $/1M tokens for convo workloads.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime kernel-selection bias -> canary us-east 2025-10-10T04:00:00Z
cheng: GPU util numbers?
maria: H100 avg GPU util ~80% under this mix, A100 ~65%. That maps to the tokens/sec gap and explains cost per token gap given same price per GPU hour. If we can negotiate H100 commit pricing, moving conv workloads to H100 looks cost-effective.
liz: Action items:
- liz: PR to prefer fast-attn for seq <= 2048 (runtime)
- maria/perf-qa: re-run with batch=8 + microbursts, attach cold/warm cache runs
- aj: add per-region $/1M token breakdown to Console metrics (include cache-warmed effective cost)
- cheng: double-check kernel selector telemetry to catch future fallbacks
maria: Filed bench ticket and uploaded raw logs/plots: go/bench/3765432100. TL;DR: For this mixed-QPS 7B workload H100 => better tokens/sec, lower decode p95, lower US $/1M tokens; watch q4_0 for small quality regressions and A100 kernel fallbacks at long sequences. :thumbsup:
